`enum StencilOperation`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StencilOperation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/StencilOperation.java)

What a draw does to the stored stencil value after the stencil and depth tests.

## Description

Each value matches the OpenGL operation of the same name, on an 8-bit stencil.
The order of the constants is part of the contract: [`StencilEmulation`](/reference/pipeline/stencilemulation/) sends their ordinal to the shader.

## Learn more

- [Stencil](/build/framebuffers-and-depth/#stencil)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`KEEP`](#StencilOperation-value-KEEP) | Leaves the stored value as it is. |
| [`ZERO`](#StencilOperation-value-ZERO) | Sets the stored value to `0`. |
| [`REPLACE`](#StencilOperation-value-REPLACE) | Sets the stored value to the reference of the [`StencilState`](/reference/pipeline/stencilstate/). |
| [`INCREMENT`](#StencilOperation-value-INCREMENT) | Adds one to the stored value, clamped at `255`. |
| [`DECREMENT`](#StencilOperation-value-DECREMENT) | Subtracts one from the stored value, clamped at `0`. |
| [`INVERT`](#StencilOperation-value-INVERT) | Flips every bit of the stored value. |
